artworks.title: D'Ayrail
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's profile in a circular frame at the top of the print. The man is depicted in profile facing right, showcasing his facial features such as his nose, beard, and curly hair. His expression is serious, with a pronounced brow line. Surrounding the portrait are decorative elements like mythical creatures, animals, and human figures intertwined with floral designs. The border includes French text and the inscription "Tho. de lœuf" and "1589." The background is filled with swirls and motifs.

artworks.title: Nicolaus Petri van Deventer
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is seated and facing forward, with a full beard and mustache. He has groomed, slightly wavy hair above the ears. He is dressed in a detailed outfit with a ruffled collar and a dark doublet. The man is holding a globular object, possibly a terrestrial globe, with both hands. There are scientific and geometric tools, such as an armillary sphere and a compass, on a table in front of him. The background includes architectural elements like a column and a cityscape, along with floating objects like a dome and a polyhedron. The background has detailed line work suggesting an outdoor setting. Above the man's head is an inscription in French and the date "1595."

artworks.title: Edward Dering, Puritan Divine
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is slightly turned to the side, looking at the viewer. The man has a bearded face with an angular jawline and prominent cheekbones. He wears a hat that covers his hair. His attire seems historical, including a coat with a fur or plush collar, a buttoned jacket, and a high-collared ruffled shirt. His right hand is raised, holding a book or a document near his chest. The background has a patterned texture, and at the bottom, there is a decorative border with an inscription identifying him as "EDOVARDVS DERINGVS" with additional text below.

artworks.title: Sir Kenelm Digby, Author and Diplomatist
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man with his right hand placed on his chest in a formal pose. His head is turned slightly to his right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The man has detailed facial features, including a long, curly beard and mustache, and long, wavy hair extending past his shoulders. He is dressed in ornate clothing with a dark garment fastened with small buttons and an outer cloak draped over his left shoulder. To the left of the figure, there is a decorative object resembling an armillary sphere. The background features lines and an archway framing the subject, with text at the bottom identifying the person as "D. KENELMVS DIGBI EQVES."

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Docwra
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing in a frontal pose. He is holding a sword in his right hand and resting his left hand on a helm placed on a pedestal. The man has a mustache and beard, and is wearing a cap over wavy hair. He is adorned in detailed armor, including a breastplate, shoulder armor, and greaves, as well as a cloak with a decorative cross. The background features an ornate arch, a celestial face decoration, distant landscapes, ships, a body of water, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Docwra, Knight of Malta
artworks.description: The image portrays a man standing upright, slightly turned to the left, with his right hand resting on a helmet on a pedestal. The man has a defined nose, full beard, mustache, broad forehead, medium-length curly hair, and wears a cap with a brim. He is adorned in detailed armor with shoulder and knee plates, a cloak, and holds a sword in his left hand on the ground. The background features hills, ships, and an ornate arch with decorative elements and a carved face in a sun at the top. The scene is on a tiled floor.

artworks.title: Rembret Dodoens
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man in a seated position, with his head turned slightly to the right. He has a long, defined beard, wearing a cap on his head. The man's facial features include distinct eyes, a prominent nose, and a calm expression. He is dressed in a robe with botanical motifs on the front. His right hand rests on a surface, while his left hand holds a plant with elongated leaves and blossoms. In the background to the upper right, there is an ornate design with a crest featuring an abstract emblem. In the upper left corner, there is text including the name "Rembertus Dodonaeus" and Latin inscriptions. The background is a simple, light-colored space that complements the detailed black and white illustration.

artworks.title: Marc Antonio de Dominis
artworks.artist: Paul Furst (publisher) after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man, depicting his head and upper torso, facing slightly to his left. He has a white beard and mustache, deep-set eyes, and wears a traditional cap. He is dressed in a buttoned garment with a high collar. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with decorative elements and a Latin inscription. The background is textured and shaded.

artworks.title: Marc Antonio de Dominis
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. He is dressed in clerical attire and wears a biretta. His face has distinct features with a strong, angular shape, prominent eyebrows, and a well-groomed full beard and mustache. The man's hair is short and peeks from beneath his cap. He is wearing a high-collared garment, likely a clerical robe, buttoned up the front. The engraving border around him is detailed and includes text, such as his name, Marcus Antonius de Dominis. The background is engraved, creating contrast with the portrait subject. The style suggests a historic or classical portrait, with fine lines and shading typical of old engravings.

artworks.title: Marc Antonio de Dominis
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man with only his head and shoulders shown. He is positioned slightly angled to his right, facing the viewer. The man appears aged with furrowed brows, deep-set eyes, a bulbous nose, and a long beard with a slight curl at the end. He has a closely trimmed mustache and some visible hair along his forehead and sides, leading into his beard. The man wears a square cap hat and a robe with a visible collar secured by a few buttons. The image is framed within an oval design with intricate patterns and text around the perimeter identifying him as Marcus Antonius de Dominis. The background is cross-hatched, providing a textured contrast to the detailed figure.

artworks.title: Hugo Donellus
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a man in a formal portrait, facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a lightly bearded face with a high forehead, deep-set eyes, and defined cheekbones. The man wears a skullcap over his hair, a garment with a fur collar, and a visible ruffled collar underneath. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background features a dark, cross-hatched pattern, and below the portrait, there is an inscription in Latin.

artworks.title: Dr. John Donne, Dean of Saint Paul's, Poet
artworks.description: This is an engraving showing a portrait of an individual. The person is depicted upright with closed eyes, a beard, and a distinctive headpiece. They are wearing a cloak or robe and the image is enclosed in an oval frame with inscribed text around it.

artworks.title: Sir Dudley Carleton, Viscount Dorchester
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving featuring the upper body of a man in a formal portrait. He is facing slightly left, looking directly at the viewer. He has a mustache and pointed beard, with short, curly hair. The man wears a richly decorated garment, a brooch, and a large lace ruff around his neck. The background is dark, with an oval frame around the figure, embellished with patterns and inscriptions. More text surrounds the outer part, possibly a dedication.

artworks.title: Sir Dudley Carleton, Viscount Dorchester
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man from the chest up, facing the viewer. He has short, curly hair, a full beard and mustache, and wears a formal, elaborate garment with a ruff collar. The background includes an oval frame and text along the border, as well as decorative lines and text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Sir Dudley Carleton, Viscount Dorchester
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man from the chest up, facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has a composed expression with facial features including a beard and mustache, and short, wavy hair. He wears an elaborate outfit typical of the period, featuring a decorated doublet and a lace ruff around his neck. The background consists of an oval frame with inscriptions, and there is text below the oval, possibly in Latin.

artworks.title: Andrea Doria
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper torso. He is turned slightly to the left, holding a long paddle-like object in his right hand. The man has a long, full beard and mustache, wavy hair, and a furrowed brow. He is dressed in a draped garment, possibly a toga, fastened with a brooch. The oval-framed image includes two cherubic figures above the man and illustrations of sea creatures at the bottom corners. The background is densely hatched, with a Latin inscription circling the oval border and a passage of text at the bottom.

artworks.title: John Doucher, French Divine
artworks.description: The image is a historical portrait of a man, seen from the upper body up. He is positioned facing slightly to his left. He wears a traditional cap and has a full beard and mustache with a slightly serious expression. His hair is short and mostly hidden. The man's clothing is formal and ornate with a fur-lined collar, high pleated shirt collar, and vertical buttons. The portrait is circular with an intricately inscribed frame including Latin text. The background is shaded with fine lines, creating texture and depth.

artworks.title: Rupert Duglass, Swedish General
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, including the shoulders and chest. The person is facing forward with a slight three-quarter turn to the left. He has a prominent nose, a neatly groomed mustache and goatee, and well-defined cheekbones. The person has long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders and wears a small cap. His attire includes a shirt with a wide lace collar under a cloak, possibly woven or fur-lined, draped over one shoulder. A visible armored vest with studs is seen beneath the cloak. The person is not holding any objects, and there is no visible jewelry. The portrait is set within an oval frame on a lined background, with a plaque beneath containing text, likely in Latin, surrounded by a textured, circular pattern.

artworks.title: Robert Duglass, Swedish General
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in an oval frame. The person is depicted from the chest up in a slightly turned position facing the right. His facial features include a long, straight nose, a prominent mustache, and wavy shoulder-length hair with curls at the ends. The individual is dressed in what appears to be a military or formal garment with riveted metal pieces, possibly armor, and a high, lace-trimmed collar. The background consists of closely spaced lines creating a textured backdrop. An inscription below the portrait reads "Robertus Duguay" with additional text in Latin.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.description: The image depicts a person with curly hair and a mustache dressed in Renaissance-style attire. They are posed facing forward with a composed expression, wearing a doublet with a ruffled lace collar, a chain, and a hand resting on a decorated helmet. A sword hangs from their belt. In the background is a hanging globe showing continents, a landscape with fields and a city, and an ornate coat of arms on the right.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man identified as Franciscus Dracus. He is depicted waist-up with a composed expression, featuring a mustache, beard, and wavy hair. He wears elaborate armor with intricate patterns and is surrounded by elements signifying exploration, such as a shield with a ship and hemispheres of a world map labeled with continents. In the background, there is Latin text and decorative elements. The setting is formal with a classical style.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man in a seated position, facing slightly to the left. His facial features include a trimmed beard and mustache, with a stern expression. His hair is styled with waves and curls sitting over his ears. He is wearing a detailed, high-collared garment with intricate patterns and puffed sleeves, adorned with straps and possibly a cloak draped over one shoulder. In his right hand, he is holding a globe. The setting appears to be an engraved illustration with a circle framing the man, containing the words "FRANCISCVS DRAKE MILES AVRATVS" around it. The background consists of a decorative, radial pattern behind the man, and the image is printed on a piece of paper with Latin text below and mirrored text visible on the back.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Drake
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of an individual positioned slightly angled to the right, with a confident expression. The person has a mustache, goatee, wavy hair parted at the middle, and is wearing formal attire with a textured tunic, collared shirt with lace detailing, a draped sash, and a ruffled ribbon. They hold a globe in their left hand. The background includes a circle with decorative text and horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Francis Drake
artworks.description: The image is an historical engraving of a man from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, with short, wavy hair and a high hairline. He wears formal attire typical of the late 16th century, including a high-collared shirt under a coat adorned with a decorative sash across the chest. The man holds a sphere in his left hand, and his right hand appears to be gesturing near the edge of a globe in front of him. The globe is detailed with representations of different continents marked with letters. Surrounding the oval frame enclosing the portrait are nautical instruments, suggesting a maritime theme. In the background, there is an elaborate engraved scene with maritime decorations, including a detailed illustration of a ship within a circular frame beside the man. The illustration is bordered by Latin text and the year "1598" is at the top.
